g.text: How much prefix overlap survives a short history window?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: Share of all requests with at least 50% full-block prefix overlap; every curve uses its full cohort denominator

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: Only strictly earlier arrivals qualify; the lower window boundary is included. Final partial blocks are excluded.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: History-window sensitivity measures available input structure. It does not measure cache TTL, residency, completion, or hits.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203342

g.text: Within-chain and cross-chain curves can share matches and must not be added.
